user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages to display answers and links in ChatGPT search.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads to ensure policy compliance.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content that may be used in training foundation models.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-triggered actions and visits in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Triggered by user questions or GPT Actions; not an automatic crawler.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to training AI models.
user_agents.scope: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by collecting public web data.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content in response to user-initiated requests in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Supports Claude AI users when asking questions requiring web content retrieval.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content specifically to enhance relevance and accuracy of user search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and performing product crawls.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features in Google Search.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for Google features and products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl commerce and shopping pages.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Perform testing tools and URL inspection crawls.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for various product teams and R&D.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible content from sites for internal research and development.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible image URLs across Google products.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Fetching publicly accessible video URLs across Google products.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Gemini models powering Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API, and Grounding with Google Search.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information automatically for search services.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers web information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology and generative AI context across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and other Apple ecosystem features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls data usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; controls training usage of data crawled by Applebot.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared across Meta apps to gather and display link previews.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger; may bypass for security checks.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, though security checks may bypass.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality, relevance, accuracy, and citations.
user_agents.scope: Navigates web content to enhance Meta AI search results and responses.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for advertising and business product improvements.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models and indexing to improve products.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because requests are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to power Bing search results and Microsoft AI experiences.
user_agents.scope: Web pages and content indexed across Microsoft search and AI ecosystem.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent bingbot.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Fetches page snapshots and previews in real time for Bing and Microsoft services.
user_agents.scope: Page snapshots and previews across Microsoft search interfaces.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent BingPreview.

user_agents.name: AdIdxBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing Ads quality assessment and ad validation.
user_agents.scope: Advertiser landing pages and related ad target URLs.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent AdIdxBot.

user_agents.name: MSNBot-Media
user_agents.purpose: Crawls multimedia, image, and video content for Bing and MSN.
user_agents.scope: Image, video, and audio assets on the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent MSNBot-Media.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to improve services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt or noarchive/noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Content eligible for search experiences like Alexa; does not crawl for generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt or noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live information fetches initiated by user requests; does not crawl for generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Fetches a randomly selected subset of the web, respecting robots.txt and sitemaps.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to the opt-out registry.
